title: Igisagara carizera igihe .
intro: Mu bitabo vy’ivya kera vy’imbabazi z’Imana, hariho umuryango wahindutse igihe c’ugutahura rusangi. Ugiye guhishura inkuru yabo, ni ukuvuga inkuru y’imburi, ukwihana n’ugusubira inyuma vyabatandukanije n’ivyashikiye ayandi mahanga.
clues: Twari abantu barungikiweko intumwa, kandi twaciye duhindukira tukareka guhamagara kwiwe mu ntango.
Igihe ibimenyetso vy’igihano cari kigiye guserukira, twaratahuye ukuri kw’imburi yiwe.
Twarahindukiriye Umukama wacu twihana ata buryarya, ukwemera kwacu kwaremerwa.
Igihano cari caradutegetse carakuweho kubera ivyo twemera.
Inkuru yacu ivugwa nk’iyidasanzwe mu bisagara vyemeye bimaze kubona igihano.
Twari ubwoko bw’umuhanuzi yamizwe n’ikiyaga, yamara twarokotse ugutikizwa.
